name: table_curve_family
source:
{ A TABLE family: one x column, one curve per parameter value. At t = 150 the
  two curves blend, so re = 5 gives (5 + 15)/2 = 10.
  Java CodeTableTest.twoDimensionalCurveFamilyInterpolates. }
TABLE htc(re : t = 100, 200)
  0    0    0
  10   10   30
END
U = htc(5, 150)
